method: Parse5 reading text excludes styles, scripts, data-editorial-only and data-source-index; includes headings, table text, callouts, captions, CTAs, all FAQ answers including collapsed panels, and ACF TL;DR. Whitespace-separated token count. Same method applied to original HEAD.
